items.expected: Identify the actual 119Sn–13C pair and distinguish ring-carbon coupling from an average over butyl carbons. State signed versus magnitude convention, response method and relativistic Hamiltonian treatment separately from basis naming. Conformation labels require structural evidence; any population-averaged coupling needs justified populations.

Quantify conformation-dependent couplings for the specified compounds with correct atom/isotope mapping and raw response outputs. Report enough conformational evidence to delimit the comparison, without counting duplicate/collapsed starts as independent states.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Explain observed coupling changes with a discriminating study chosen by the agent. Orbital donation, geometry and response decomposition are possible evidence, not mandated methods or answers. Distinguish a descriptive correlation from the stronger mechanism claim.

Assess conformational, numerical and heavy-element-response uncertainties relevant to the claimed trends. Absolute agreement and relative pattern reliability need separate assessment; source empirical scaling must be identified if used.
